news.title: Spotify and Universal Music strike deal allowing fan-made AI covers and remixes
news.description: Spotify is partnering with  Universal Music Group￼ to let Premium subscribers create AI-generated song covers and remixes, with participating artists receiving a share of the revenue.

news.title: Trump delays AI security executive order, saying language ‘could have been a blocker’
news.description: President Trump delayed signing an executive order that would have required pre-release government security reviews of AI models, citing dissatisfaction with the order's language.

news.title: Spotify adds AI-powered Q&A and briefing generation features to podcasts
news.description: Spotify will let you generate daily or weekly briefs based on your prompts

news.title: Can OpenAI’s ‘Master of Disaster’ Fix AI’s Reputation Crisis?
news.description: Global affairs chief Chris Lehane wants to tone down the debate over AI’s societal impacts—and get states to pass laws that won’t derail OpenAI’s meteoric rise.

news.title: Meta Is in Crisis, Google Search’s Makeover, and AI Gets Booed by Graduates
news.description: In this episode of Uncanny Valley, we unpack the mass layoffs at Meta, big announcements at Google I/O, and the latest backlash against AI.

news.title: I Cloned Myself With Gemini’s AI Avatar Tool. The Result Was Unnervingly Me
news.description: I used the Gemini app to generate lifelike videos featuring a digital clone of myself. Google sees this as the future of creation. I’m still creeped out.

news.title: SpaceX Is Spending $2.8 Billion to Buy Gas Turbines for Its AI Data Centers
news.description: The investment comes as Elon Musk’s AI unit faces complaints about the carbon-emitting units and looks to become a big player in cloud computing.
